subject: general
question: What is the states' share in the divisible pool of central taxes as per the Sixteenth Finance Commission (FC-16), which was tabled in Parliament on February 1, 2026, regarding the fiscal recommendation for the five years between 2026-27 and 2030-31?
solution:
The correct answer is __**41%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Report of the 16th Finance Commission, chaired by Dr. Arvind Panagariya, was tabled in Parliament on February 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Commission recommended that the share of states in the divisible pool of central taxes remain at 41% for the period 2026-31.**
 
• This recommendation maintains consistency with the share previously recommended by the 15th Finance Commission.
 
• The divisible pool refers to the portion of gross tax revenue distributed to states after excluding collection costs, cesses, and surcharges.
 
• Sixteenth Finance Commission (FC-16)__
 __
 
• Chairman - Dr. Arvind Panagariya
 
• Recommendation Period - 2026-27 to 2030-31
 
• Vertical Devolution - 41%
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Divisible Pool__

 __
 
• It comprises the net proceeds of all taxes and duties referred to in the Union List, except for certain specific exclusions like Surcharge and Cesses.
 
 
 
• Devolution Criteria Changes__
 __
 
• The FC-16 introduced "Contribution to GDP" as a new criterion with a 10% weightage.
 
• The weightage for "Income Distance" was reduced from 45% (15th FC) to 42.5%.
 
• "Tax and Fiscal Efforts" was removed as a parameter in the FC-16 formula.
 
 
 
• Constitutional Basis__
 
 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body formed under Article 280 to define the financial relations between the central government and the individual state governments.
